explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 36. Timing (rising strongly late in the episode, high at D1, near 0 at GO/D2) explains R^2 0.79. Beyond timing, the magnitude is almost all at D1 and set by the previous trial's choice/state/reward: highest after a1 S2 rewarded (+0.37), then a1 S2 unrewarded (+0.15), a1 S1 r (+0.08), a2 S2 r (+0.06); lowest after a2 S1 unrewarded (-0.31), a1 S1 u (-0.19), a2 S2 u (-0.16), a2 S1 r (-0.10). Roughly: rewarded raises it, a1 choice raises it, reaching S2 after a1 raises it. This one fixed-shape last-trial table alone gives dev R^2 0.68 beyond timing. Small additions: graded ideal-observer belief log-odds (S1 good -> higher) at all phases, a GO bump after a1->S2, a slight decrease if the trial two back was rewarded, and a reward x belief interaction at D1; total test R^2 beyond timing 0.695 (all-observed ceiling 0.75, all 0.81). Observed-only terms; no model value/policy used. The earlier model-based explanation is not needed: the policy-decile reference alone is 0.39, below the last-trial table (0.68), so restricting to observed quantities loses little (~0.05 below the observed ceiling). Future/hidden variables (this reward 0.00, good state 0.05) add almost nothing.

issues: Minor overclaim on the numbers: the fixed-shape D1 last-trial table on its own scores test R^2 beyond timing 0.655, not 0.68. 0.68 is the reference score for a phase-specific last-trial table fitted at all three phases, not for this one term. Adding belief_lo at every phase raises it to 0.679, and the full 7-term set reproduces the reported 0.695.

Gap to the observed-only ceiling (0.75) is about 0.055, but no large systematic error class remains. Misses gives mean phase errors of +0.007 at D1, -0.005 at GO and -0.002 at D2. The largest (phase x previous trial) cells are D1 after a1 S2 r at +0.040, D1 after a2 S1 u at +0.033 and D1 after a1 S2 u at -0.032.

The worst-fit windows are late in the episode (trials 90-99), where GO/D2 values after a1 choices sit well above prediction (e.g. actual 0.45 vs predicted 0.20). Letting the effects grow with episode time (table x ep_dec, table x exp(ep_trial/20), belief x exp(ep_trial/20)) recovers almost none of this: each adds about +0.002, or reaches 0.684-0.688 on a 4-term base that scores 0.679. So it does not show up as a gain effect that terms can capture.

Adding a trial-two-back table at D1 (two-back action, state and reward, replacing the reward x belief term) brings the test score only to 0.701, so the explanation is close to as good as these cues allow.

The checked claims hold: reward adds about 0.22 at D1 across all four choice x state pairs; a1 and S2 both raise it, with an extra boost for a1->S2; the GO bump after a1->S2 has a positive weight (+0.031); the two-back reward weight is negative (-0.02); belief_lo weights are positive at all phases; timing alone gives 0.79; the policy-decile reference is 0.39.
